payload.claim: The module docstring says 'This module only chooses the pairs. `SA-0402` runs them,' but this diff adds `describe_parent_versions`, a line-formatting function, to this same module. Every sibling of that function (`describe_wrong_versions`, `describe_criterion_probes`, `describe_probes`) lives in `saffron/phases/review.py`, the module that runs and reports REVIEW's pairs, not in the module that only chooses them. The docstring next to the new function now contradicts the module's own stated scope one line above it.
